Night Cream Price in India: Honest Price Bands and Value per Gram

By Mohammed Nihal, founderPublished 16 October 2026Updated 16 October 20265 min read
Quick answer

Most everyday night creams in India cost roughly ₹300–₹1,500, with basic creams below and premium creams above. Compare by price per gram: divide the price by the grams. Most people use 10–15 g a month. Mirc Glow night creams range from ₹349 to ₹2,499, with free shipping.

Night cream price in India ranges from under ₹200 for basic moisturisers to several thousand rupees for imported or premium jars. For most people, a good everyday night cream costs somewhere between ₹300 and ₹1,500, and the most useful way to compare any two is the price per gram, not the sticker price.

This guide gives honest price bands by type, what you actually get at each level, how to work out cost per gram and per month, and our own prices so you can compare clearly.

Night cream price in India by type

Prices change often and vary by seller, so take these as rough bands you will commonly see when you shop online, not fixed rules:

Type of night creamRough price bandWhat you usually get
Basic moisturising creamUnder ₹300Simple moisture; few or no active ingredients
Everyday cream with one or two actives₹300–₹800Moisture plus niacinamide, aloe vera or similar
Multi-ingredient brightening or glow cream₹800–₹2,000Several actives such as vitamin C, kojic acid, glutathione
Advanced or premium cream₹2,000 and aboveMore complex formulas, larger brands, imported jars

A higher price does not always mean a better cream for you. It might pay for advertising, packaging or import costs rather than what is inside the jar.

How to work out price per gram

Divide the price by the number of grams. For example, ₹649 ÷ 30 g is about ₹21.6 per gram. Now you can compare a 10 g jar with a 50 g jar like for like.

Then think per month. A pea-sized amount for the face and a little for the neck is roughly 0.3–0.5 g per night, so most people use about 10–15 g a month. At ₹21.6 per gram, that is roughly ₹215–₹325 a month.

Check whether the size is in grams or millilitres. Creams are usually sold by weight; ml is close but not exact.

Buying night cream online in India: what to check

  • Full ingredient list. If you cannot see what is inside, do not buy.
  • Batch number and expiry date printed on the jar or box.
  • Sealed packaging. A broken seal is a reason to return it.
  • Honest claims. Be careful with promises to change skin colour or show results overnight.
  • Shipping and returns. Check delivery charges and the return policy before you pay.
  • Payment options. Cash on Delivery is useful when buying from a brand for the first time.

When you buy night cream online in India from us, shipping is free, delivery usually takes 3–7 days, you can pay by Cash on Delivery or an online payment link, and sealed jars can be returned within 7 days. You can also order on WhatsApp at +91 99808 81230. Details are on our shipping policy and returns and refunds pages.

Is a more expensive night cream better?

Not automatically. The right cream is one that suits your skin type, feels good enough to use every night, and fits your budget for months, not weeks. A ₹649 cream used every night will usually do more than a ₹3,000 cream used twice a week. Our guide to the best night cream for glowing skin explains what to look for beyond price, and how to apply night cream helps a jar last longer.

Whatever you buy, patch test it for two to three nights first, and wear sunscreen every morning if it contains kojic acid, alpha arbutin or vitamin C.

Short answers

What is the price of night cream in India? Most everyday night creams cost roughly ₹300–₹1,500, with basic creams below that and premium creams above.

How do I compare night cream prices? Divide the price by the grams in the jar to get the price per gram.

Is there a good night cream under ₹500? Yes. Small jars and simple moisturising creams are available under ₹500, including our 15 g Avocado Glow Cream at ₹399.

How long does a 30 g night cream last? Roughly two to three months with a pea-sized amount every night.

Does Mirc Glow charge for shipping? No. Shipping is free across India, usually in 3–7 days.

This is general skincare information, not medical advice. Patch test any new product, and see a dermatologist if you have a skin condition.
